name: Meridia's Order

startedBy.speaker: Paladin Marith
startedBy.prompt: You lead, I'll follow.
reply: Really? Just like that?
I expected you to question me a little more. Nevermind, I'll escort you to the Sanctum

startedBy.speaker: Paladin Marith
startedBy.prompt: I'll do no such thing. Now leave me alone.
reply: You and Laracin will get along famously.
Fine, follow me, don't follow me. It's up to you. Meridia's Sanctum isn't far from Mount Kilkreath.
When you've decided to behave like a true champion of Meridia, Alara wants to speak with you there.

startedBy.speaker: Paladin Marith
startedBy.prompt: Lead the way.
reply: Thank you. It's not too far from Meridia's Statue. I'll escort you there.

firstObjective.text: Speak with High Priestess Alara at Meridia's Sanctum

movedBy.speaker: High Priestess Alara
movedBy.prompt: What would you like me to do?
reply: We've received word that a Necromancer has taken up residence in Solitude.
Usually, I'd dispatch one of our Paladins under the protection of Meridia to purge the evil from the city, but these are uncertain times.
To be truthful, our Lady has not spoken to us in... Well, a long time. I can't risk one of my people. And I hear you have a reputation for this work.
This Necromancer has been practicing their vile arts in the Hall of the Dead, defiling corpses and violating the sanctity of death.
Exterminate them with the full spite of Meridia's power. Then return to me.
I am sending Paladin Marith with you. She will observe you. Not that I won't trust your word but it's better to be sure.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is High Priestess Alara

movedBy.speaker: High Priestess Alara
reply: We're traveling to the Shrine of Meridia. It's not far.
I'll need to speak with you when we get there. Away from... open ears.
I'll lead the way.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is High Priestess Alara; Our Lady stage == 10

firstObjective.text: Speak with Alara in Meridia's Sanctum

objective.text: Ask members of Meridia's Order about Findar

movedBy.speaker: High Priestess Alara
reply: Well, the only person who knows it location now is Findar and I have no idea where he is.
Try speaking to the others. They might know where he's ended up.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is High Priestess Alara

movedBy.speaker: Arch-Paladin Laracin
reply: Luckily for you, whilst you were dealing with that Findar fool, I arranged for you to meet their recruiter.
They're openly recruiting. Well, as openly as a group of Necromancers can recruit. I expect they'll want you to prove yourself worthy in some way.
Whatever it is, I recommend you just do it. Sometimes it is necessary to sacrifice your morals for the greater good.
Once there, hopefully you will be invited to join them, and given the location of their hideout. Once you're inside, it's all up to you.
Do whatever you can to find out what they're planning - but let me be clear, this is not a purging mission.
I expect you'll find them more useful alive. That being said, if you are compromised, I expect you to do what you must.
You're meeting their recruiter at Deep Moon Lookout. Your name is Remidai. Unless there are any questions, I'd suggest you be on your way.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Arch-Paladin Laracin

scenesStarted.speaker: Dralos
scenesStarted.prompt: What do I have to do?
reply: Well, we've brought a friend to meet you. She was a little shy at first but I think she's really taken to the idea of getting to know you.
Kill her.
Then we'll talk about you joining the Dark Dawn.
scenesStarted.conditions: the speaker is Dralos; Infiltration stage == 20

startedBy.speaker: Tahlani
startedBy.prompt: It's good to meet you.
reply: My names Tahlani. I'm responsible for giving our new members the briefing. What to do, where not to go. Oh, and to give you your robes.
Now, as for what to do, there isn't much at the moment. Reeshi is our leader. I suppose you could try talking to him.
As for where not to go, do not, I repeat, do not go into Reeshi's bedroom. He's very protective over it. Not that I'm sure why.
Well, it's not like you could get in there anyway. He's the only one with the key. I think he has important papers from the other Necromancer groups.
Here's your robes and your key to the Sanctuary.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Tahlani; fn84 == 0; GetIsRace Skyrim.esm:013743 == 0

startedBy.speaker: Tahlani
startedBy.prompt: It's good to meet you.
reply: Finally, another Altmer. Someone to match my intelligence! It's so dull around here without someone to talk to. I'm Tahlani.
Well, there is Anvaril but he bores me. I hope we'll be fast friends. Allow me to give you some advice.
Stay on Reeshi's good side, or your out. Never go into his room. It's the locked door. He's very protective over it. He must have something hidden.
Well, it's not like you could get in there anyway. He's the only one with the key. I think he has important papers from the other Necromancer groups.
Speak to Reeshi, see if there's anything he needs you to do and hopefully he'll let you in on the grand plan.
Here's your robes and key to the Sanctuary.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Tahlani; GetIsRace Skyrim.esm:013743 == 1; fn84 == 0

startedBy.speaker: Tahlani
startedBy.prompt: He said he wanted to stop off in Markarth for some supplies. (Persuade)
reply: I do wish that man would stop dallying.
Well, welcome to the Dark Dawn. I'm Tahlani, I'm charged with briefing the new recruits. What to do, where not to go... And such.
As for where not to go, do not, I repeat, do not go into Reeshi's bedroom. He's very protective over it. Not that I'm sure why.
Well, it's not like you could get in there anyway. He's the only one with the key. I think he has important papers from the other Necromancer groups.
Here's your robes and key. Don't wear them out.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Tahlani; GetActorValue >= SpeechVeryEasy (now 10); GetIsRace Skyrim.esm:013743 == 0

startedBy.speaker: Tahlani
startedBy.prompt: He said he wanted to stop off in Markarth for some supplies. (Persuade)
reply: Oh good! I thought you were a lunatic. It would be just my luck that the only other Altmer here isn't completely screwed on.
Well, there is Anvaril but he bores me. I hope we'll be fast friends. Allow me to give you some advice.
Stay on Reeshi's good side, or your out. Never go into his room. It's the locked door. He's very protective over it. He must have something hidden.
Well, it's not like you could get in there anyway. He's the only one with the key. I think he has important papers from the other Necromancer groups.
Speak to Reeshi, see if there's anything he needs you to do and hopefully he'll let you in on the grand plan.
Here's your robes and key to the Sanctuary.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Tahlani; GetActorValue >= SpeechVeryEasy (now 10); GetIsRace Skyrim.esm:013743 == 1

objective.text: Kill or warn the Markarth Court Member

movedBy.speaker: Reeshi
reply: There is a member of the Jarl's court in Markarth petitioning with the other Holds to put a tighter grip on Necromancy and those who practice it.
Moons ago, The Malevolent attacked Markarth in order to announce their presence in Skyrim.
Whilst others were sure it was a Forsworn conspiracy, Idina of the Court saw it for what it was. Now she wants us gone.
Naturally we would welcome the challenge of a worthless highborn, but being at such a critical stage in our plans, we can not afford any delays.
Kill this blasphemer for us and bring glory to the Dark Dawn.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Reeshi; The Dark Dawn stage == 10

movedBy.speaker: Initiate Velteth
reply: Champion, when you have the time, I wish to speak with you about a matter of high importance.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Initiate Velteth

movedBy.speaker: High Priestess Alara
reply: This arrived whilst you were with the Dark Dawn. Take a look.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is High Priestess Alara; A New Day stage == 10

movedBy.speaker: Initiate Garin
movedBy.prompt: So, how do we do it?
reply: As for finding someone who has entered the realm, frankly I have no idea.
However, if you were to bring them back here, I'm certain I could transfer their essence to yours, transporting you to Coldharbour.
It's a risk... It would almost certainly cause their mind to permanently collapse, but I'm sure you would be safe.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Initiate Garin

firstObjective.text: Find a way to destroy the pocket realm

scenesStarted.speaker: Initiate Garin
reply: You've done it, Champion! This place is done for. Stay still so I can transport us back!
scenesStarted.conditions: The Pocket Realm stage == 20; the speaker is Initiate Garin

secondStep.unread: nothing outside its own stage fragments sets stage 20 or one before it

startedBy.speaker: Alzacar
reply: Welcome to Coldharbour. The Dark Master has been expecting you.
This way please...
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Alzacar; A Fate Worse Than Death hasn't started

reply: Well, as frustrating as I find your resolve - it is predicable.
You were a fool to come here. This realm responds to my decree. It was crafted to meet my demands and to serve our great purpose.
Here I will coordinate our hostilities across not only Skyrim, but across all of Tamriel. Councilors, Chancellors, all will answer to me.
They will do as I command or face the wrath of my undead legions.
When Lamae is mine to control, she will unlock an old and powerful vein of necromancy this world has not seen since the 1st Era.
You wish to test my power? I will show you.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Meridia.esp:019A8D; A Fate Worse Than Death stage >= 0; A Fate Worse Than Death stage <= 10

reply: Well, as frustrating as I find your resolve - it is predicable.
You were a fool to come here. This realm responds to my decree. It was crafted to meet my demands and to serve our great purpose.

movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Meridia.esp:019A8D; A Fate Worse Than Death stage >= 0; A Fate Worse Than Death stage <= 10

reply: Welcome to my dungeon. I do hope you don't mind that I brought guests.
As you can see, my minions have captured two members from your pathetic Order.
The time has come for you to pay for your crimes against The Malevolent. I'm almost too excited to say it. It's so delightfully delicious.
I'm going to hold you here until you kill them.
No, really. I mean it. Once you kill them, I'll give you the key to leave the dungeon. There's no way around it!
Oh, look at your face. Okay, fine. I'm not entirely without mercy. I suppose I can make an exception...
I'll let you kill just one!
See? That's more of a kindness than you've shown my associates. I'll wait for you in the main hall. The anticipation is killing me!
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Meridia.esp:019A8D; A Fate Worse Than Death stage == 20

quests.name: The Jester, In The Bedroom, With The Knife

startedBy.speaker: The Jester
startedBy.prompt: How can we do it?
reply: You've already met Alzacar. He's Fiya's most trusted servant, but not her most loyal.
He's refused to help me in the past, mostly out of obligation to Molag Bal. But if we can somehow convince him...
I'm sure he'd know how to destroy this place.
If we can find something to show Alzacar how much Fiya disregards her servants, maybe we can get him on our side.
The moment you find anything, bring it to me. I don't know how much longer Fiya will tolerate you in her realm.

firstObjective.text: Find a way to turn Alzacar against Fiya

movedBy.speaker: Alzacar
reply: Champion, I will help you with your intentions.
I know the secret to unraveling this realm. As does one other. Kelrog.
Kelrog is fiercely loyal to the Dark Master. If he catches on to what we're doing, this will all be for nothing. He needs to be removed. Permanently.
Once you've killed him, we should meet no resistance in completing our mission. The Dremora are too dense to understand.
When this place begins to erupt, it will be chaos. The Dremora will turn to a frenzy. You could look for a distraction to make your escape.
Consider speaking to the slaves. They could be willing to lend their support.
Go with haste. The faster we act, the higher our chances of success. And be discreet. If the Dremora see you kill Kelrog, they'll kill you.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Alzacar; fn84 == 0

movedBy.speaker: Alzacar
reply: Champion, I will help you with your intentions.
I know the secret to unraveling this realm. As does one other. Kelrog.
Kelrog is fiercely loyal to the Dark Master. If he catches on to what we're doing, this will all be for nothing. He needs to be removed. Permanently.
Once you've killed him, we should meet no resistance in completing our mission. The Dremora are too dense to understand.
When this place begins to erupt, it will be chaos. The Dremora will turn to a frenzy. With Cleans-Your-Boots dead, we have no hope for allies.
Go with haste. The faster we act, the higher our chances of success. And be discreet. If the Dremora see you kill Kelrog, they'll kill you.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Alzacar; fn84 == 1

scenesStarted.speaker: The Jester
reply: Let's have a look.
This is outrageous. She plans to do away with all of us.
We must show this to Alzacar. He's sure to side with us then.
scenesStarted.conditions: the speaker is The Jester; The Jester, In The Bedroom, With The Knife stage == 10; GetItemCount To Malfyur == 1

movedBy.speaker: High Priestess Alara
reply: Meridia watch over us all.
Champion, lead the way to the Ritual Site. We must stop this from going any further.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is High Priestess Alara

scenesStarted.speaker: High Priestess Alara
reply: Good. Give me a moment. I need to speak with the others.
scenesStarted.conditions: the speaker is High Priestess Alara; The Ritual stage == 10

startedBy.speaker: Paladin Asger
startedBy.prompt: I can help with that.
reply: Good. The man who raised his concerns is called Arandar. Pompous little clothes. Can't miss him.
Lead the way to Riften, Champion.

startedBy.speaker: Paladin Asger
startedBy.prompt: I'll think about it.
reply: By all means.

startedBy.speaker: Paladin Asger
startedBy.prompt: I'll join you on your warlock hunt.
reply: Good. The man who raised his concerns is called Arandar. Pompous little clothes. Can't miss him.
Lead the way to Riften, Champion.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Paladin Asger; Champion's Choice stage == 5

movedBy.speaker: Arandar
movedBy.prompt: I'm here to investigate your claims about a warlock.
reply: Yes, finally someone listens. The guards here are too corrupt to do anything about it, and Gods know they won't go into the Ratway.
There's a wizard living among us who practices dark magic in secret. Playing with elements like that... It isn't natural for us Nords.
One evening, I was taking a stroll just outside of the gate, and there I saw him torturing animals. Rabbits, deer, even a horse.
This wouldn't be so bad, no different to hunting - except he doesn't kill them. Just leaves them there, laying in misery. Such a monster!
If he's capable of doing that to serve his own desires, who knows what else he could do? First animals, then our citizens!
Trouble is, he saw me and then he fled! Scurried away into the Ratway with the other vermin.
Hurry, if you go now I'm certain you can find him and end his miserable existence.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Arandar; Champion's Choice stage == 10

startedBy.speaker: Initiate Garin
startedBy.prompt: I'd be happy to come along with you.
reply: Thank you, Champion. Let us search Windhelm together and I'm sure she'll turn up.

startedBy.speaker: Initiate Garin
startedBy.prompt: I'll think about it.
reply: I understand.

startedBy.speaker: Initiate Garin
startedBy.prompt: I'll join you in your search for your Cult Leader.
reply: Thank you, Champion. Let us search Windhelm together and I'm sure she'll turn up.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Initiate Garin; Repentance Upheld stage == 5

firstObjective.text: Find the Cult Leader in Windhelm

holds.name: Rosette
where: Hall of the Dead, Windhelm Hall of the Dead

ways.cell: Hall of the Dead, Windhelm Hall of the Dead

movedBy.speaker: Rosette
speakerPlaced: Hall of the Dead, Windhelm Hall of the Dead
reply: Garin... I thought it was you I saw skulking around Windhelm. I'd know that face anywhere, even in it's current state...
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Rosette

startedBy.speaker: Arch-Paladin Laracin
startedBy.prompt: Is there anything I can do to help?
reply: When we initially came to Fort Justice, I was certain the Vigilants of Stendarr would be an ally to us.
As you've seen, it would appear their narrow-minded thinking is preventing them from seeing our purity. As such, they pose a threat to our Order.
It is my duty as Arch-Paladin to wipe them out from Stendarr's Beacon. Will you join me, Champion? It would be my pleasure.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Arch-Paladin Laracin; The Ritual stage == 80; NMeridiaVigilantMisc stage >= 10; Stendarr's Mercy hasn't started

startedBy.speaker: Arch-Paladin Laracin
startedBy.prompt: I'll happily join you.
reply: Remarkable. I suspect we only need to extinguish the leader of the Beacon, but I'm certain Meridia will appreciate us going the extra mile.
Lead us up the hill to Stendarr's Beacon, Champion and we will end this threat against our Order.

startedBy.speaker: Arch-Paladin Laracin
startedBy.prompt: I'll think about it.
reply: Very well. My only hope is that you reach your conclusion swiftly.

startedBy.speaker: Arch-Paladin Laracin
startedBy.prompt: I will help you destroy the Vigilants at Stendarr's Beacon.
reply: Remarkable. I suspect we only need to extinguish the leader of the Beacon, but I'm certain Meridia will appreciate us going the extra mile.
Lead us up the hill to Stendarr's Beacon, Champion and we will end this threat against our Order.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Arch-Paladin Laracin; Stendarr's Mercy stage == 5

objective.text: Kill the Vigilant Leader or make a truce

movedBy.speaker: Arch-Paladin Laracin
movedBy.prompt: I'm Meridia's Champion for a reason. This is what is best for the Order.
reply: Hmm... You make a compelling case. Fine, but I will accompany you nonetheless.These Vigilants are not to be trusted.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Arch-Paladin Laracin

scenesStarted.speaker: Vigilant Archeus
scenesStarted.prompt: Meridia's Order would like to make a truce.
reply: A truce? Stendarr's Vigilants do not negotiate with heretics. The only reason I let you live is because we were outnumbered at your fort.
This our territory and now you are the one who is outnumbered. I have no doubt that this conversation will end very differently.
scenesStarted.conditions: the speaker is Vigilant Archeus; Stendarr's Mercy stage == 15

startedBy.speaker: Acolyte Una
startedBy.prompt: I'll come with you to speak to Alara.
reply: Thank you... I appreciate it.

startedBy.speaker: Acolyte Una
startedBy.prompt: I'll have to think about it.
reply: I know, I'm asking a lot. You and Alara seem close. I wouldn't want to jeopardize that.

startedBy.speaker: Acolyte Una
startedBy.prompt: I'll come with you to speak to Alara.
reply: Thank you... I appreciate it.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Acolyte Una; Finding Yourself stage == 5

objective.text: Travel to Meridia's Shrine with Una

movedBy.speaker: High Priestess Alara
reply: Meridia be with you both.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is High Priestess Alara

startedBy.speaker: Initiate Valrar
startedBy.prompt: I'll have to think about it.
reply: Okay. I just thought if you were ever passing Riverwood... Never mind.

startedBy.speaker: Initiate Valrar
startedBy.prompt: I'll get your ring for you.
reply: Thank you, Champion. That means a lot to me.
You should still be able to find him in Riverwood. Just... Don't kill him. That's not what I want. Maybe you can persuade him somehow.

startedBy.speaker: Initiate Valrar
startedBy.prompt: I'll get your ring for you.
reply: Thank you, Champion. That means a lot to me.
You should still be able to find him in Riverwood. Just... Don't kill him. That's not what I want. Maybe you can persuade him somehow.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Initiate Valrar; A Parting Gift stage == 5

movedBy.speaker: Dario
reply: Pleasure doing business with you. Give Valrar my best.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Dario; the player has at least 3000 gold

movedBy.speaker: Dario
movedBy.prompt: Come on, do the right thing for Valrar. (Persuade)
reply: Fine. You're right. He was always good to me. It's not his fault that things had to end.
Take it, and give him my best.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Dario; GetActorValue >= SpeechHard (now 75)

movedBy.speaker: Dario
reply: Fine. You're obviously desperate. I'll settle for half. Consider it a favor to Valrar.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Dario; GetActorValue >= SpeechAverage (now 50); the player has at least 1500 gold

movedBy.speaker: Dario
reply: I'd consider it. If you even had that much!
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Dario; GetActorValue >= SpeechAverage (now 50); gold < 1500

movedBy.speaker: Dario
movedBy.prompt: Turns out it's stolen. You'd better give it to me to hold on to. (Persuade)
reply: Stolen!? That fool, giving me a stolen piece of jewelry. What if I got caught? I can't afford to spend time in jail!
Take it. Throw it in a river or something.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Dario; GetActorValue >= SpeechVeryHard (now 100)

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
